title: Recover measured Windows network throughput when adapter statistics are unavailable.
changes: Read cumulative RX/TX bytes from active Windows interfaces through bounded native netsh output when PowerShell adapter counters are absent.
Derive bytes per second from two real monotonically increasing samples, never from reported link speed, fabricated zero samples or packet counts.
Exclude disconnected interfaces and reject malformed, oversized or unsafe counters; retain fallback to the previous adapter statistics source.
Preserve ReMCP 0.2.220 disk, PDF and Windows screenshot reliability fixes.
